At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
As a Senior Data Scientist - ML Engineering , you will join the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in San José, Costa Rica . In this role, you will own the end-to-end path from machine learning models to scalable, reliable production systems supporting global Roche affiliates. Operating across the full MLOps and software engineering stack, you will architect cloud-native ML pipelines, build automated testing and CI/CD frameworks, instrument model observability, and set high software craftsmanship standards across the engineering team.
The Opportunity
ML Systems & Platform Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end production ML services, training pipelines, containerization, and orchestration (Airflow/Dagster) with strict SLAs for performance and cost.
MLOps Capability Building: Design reusable MLOps platform components including feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
Model Accuracy & Observability: Build automated back-testing frameworks and instrumentation for tracking data/concept drift, feature anomalies, and model performance decay, translating diagnostic findings into root-cause fixes.
Cloud & Pipeline Automation: Implement cloud-native ML infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP, systematically automating manual tasks and maintaining data synchronization contracts.
Technical Leadership & Coaching: Establish engineering standards through code reviews, refactoring research code, and mentoring data scientists on production-grade software practices.
Stakeholder Support: Partner with global affiliate teams to explain predictive model outputs, address business needs, and incorporate feedback into technical roadmaps.
Who You Are
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a quantitative discipline.
7+ years of relevant experience running and maintaining machine learning systems in production environments.
Deep proficiency in Python, Linux/Bash, SQL, modern pipeline tools (Spark, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks), and clean API design.
Hands-on expertise with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), MLOps tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases), orchestration (Airflow), and CI/CD automation.
Proven experience in cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, time-series forecasting).
Strong analytical mindset focused on quality control, data contracts, and system observability (experience with LLMOps, streaming/Kafka, or GPU workloads is a plus).
Must be currently based in Costa Rica or hold valid work authorization for San José.
No relocation benefits are offered for this position.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
As a Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI , you will join the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in San José, Costa Rica . In this hands-on, high-impact role, you will design and deploy cutting-edge agentic capabilities and enterprise Generative AI applications. Moving seamlessly across the full product stack—from problem framing and data retrieval to multi-agent flow design, API development, and LLMOps evaluation—you will serve as a subject matter expert driving state-of-the-art AI architectures into production.
The Opportunity
Agentic Application Design: Architect end-to-end multi-agent applications, retrieval layer solutions, and foundational AI capabilities, taking ideas from prototype to production deployment.
Advanced RAG & Retrieval: Build and optimize advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, incorporating vector/graph databases, reranking algorithms, chunking strategies, and hybrid retrieval.
Production-Grade Engineering: Write clean, tested Python code, manage APIs, enforce version control, and set up CI/CD pipelines for Generative AI systems.
LLMOps & System Observability: Implement evaluation harnesses, prompt/version management, cost/latency optimization, and token economics monitoring for production agents.
Strategic AI Consulting: Influence technical priorities across global enterprise stakeholders, evaluating when to deploy GenAI versus classical ML or deterministic engineering methods.
Mentorship & Collaboration: Coach team members on agentic flow design and partner with Product Owners to align technical execution with user experience strategy.
Who You Are
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related quantitative field.
7+ years of professional experience, with demonstrated hands-on expertise building enterprise Generative AI products and agentic workflows.
Deep technical mastery of LLMs, vector databases, graph databases, reranking algorithms, and Agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AWS AgentCore).
Proven track record in RAG architecture design, chunking optimization, and retrieval quality evaluation.
Solid software engineering skills in Python, SQL (and AI-generated SQL), API development, and MLOps/LLMOps monitoring platforms.
Familiarity with agent protocols (MCP, A2A), multimodal AI applications, and frontend/UI tools (Figma, React, Angular) is advantageous.
Must be currently based in Costa Rica or hold valid work authorization for San José.
No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
In this role, you will lead instrumentation software development for digital pathology solutions that directly transform patient diagnostics. You will join a dynamic, collaborative team in designing and building scalable applications—from initial concept and backend logic to UI and full end-to-end system integration.
The Opportunity
Lead software development and integration efforts for complex digital pathology instrumentation and robotic systems.
Design and maintain elegant, scalable code using C#, C/C++, .NET, and Linux for both backend logic and user interface layers.
Develop and execute unit, subsystem, and integration testing to ensure high product quality and reliability.
Collaborate within an Agile environment with solution architects, hardware engineers, and software leads to translate business requirements into robust technical reality.
Mentor and guide fellow engineers, fostering technical growth and sharing best practices across multi-disciplinary project teams.
Drive technical innovation by prototyping new software systems and leveraging shared architecture components across solutions.
Who You Are
You hold a BS/BA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
You have 6 years of medical hardware device and/or diagnostics instrument experience
You have 6+ years of technical knowledge of C#, C/C++, Linux, .NET, Angular, and distributed systems or robotics.
You have 3 years of firmware development (C/C++)
You have a proven track record of taking software projects from idea to final release using solid system design principles.
You are familiar with modern development methodologies, such as the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or Scrum.
You excel at explaining technical concepts, mentoring team members, and working effectively with diverse stakeholders across engineering disciplines.
